gaps.name: Tappable link entities in message text
gaps.whatItIs: Modern clients render message text through a CoreText label that turns every text entity (url, textUrl, mention, mentionName, hashtag, cashtag, phone, email, bank card) into a tappable run with highlight-on-touch, and route the tap through the internal link resolver.
gaps.whyItMatters: Today a link inside a message body is dead text. The only tappable thing is the preview bubble, so any message with a link and no preview (t.me/username, tg:// links, hashtags, @mentions, mailto) cannot be opened at all, and a hidden textUrl never reveals its real target.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m message body label (currently a plain UILabel; ChatViewCell.m still uses a UITextView with dataDetectorTypes, which bypasses openLink: and jumps straight to Safari). Needs a small CoreText/UILabel hit-test label; feed it +[TGClient tappableEntitiesIn:] and call the existing -openLink:.
tdlib: getTextEntities / message formatted_text entities - already wrapped as +[TGClient tappableEntitiesIn:] in TGClient+WebLinks.h (currently unused by any screen)

gaps.name: Internal link routing beyond message links
gaps.whatItIs: UrlHandling maps every resolved InternalLinkType onto a screen: public chat/username, chat invite, sticker set, bot start, video chat, story, proxy, language pack, background, folder invite.
gaps.whyItMatters: -openLink: only handles kind=="message" inside the currently open chat; everything else falls through to the Safari confirmation sheet or a flat 'This link cannot be opened.' Yet we already have every destination screen (profile, invite links, sticker strip, proxy, folders, stories). A tapped t.me/durov should open the profile, not Safari.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m -openLink: (line ~3162), promoted to a shared router so QR scan, search results and other screens use it too.
tdlib: searchPublicChat, checkChatInviteLink, joinChatByInviteLink, getStickerSet - all already wrapped

gaps.name: Handling tg:// and t.me URLs arriving from other apps
gaps.whatItIs: Opening a Telegram link from Safari, Mail or another app launches the client and navigates to the target.
gaps.whyItMatters: Info.plist already claims the tg: and telegram: URL schemes, so iOS hands us those links and we silently drop them - worse than not registering the scheme. AppDelegate -handleOpenURL: only understands the itglegacy:// debug hosts.
gaps.whereItGoes: AppDelegate.m -handleOpenURL: (line 244): anything that is not the itglegacy scheme goes to the shared link router above.

gaps.name: Composer link preview panel
gaps.whatItIs: While typing a message containing a URL, a panel above the input shows the preview that will be attached, with a close button to disable it, and (modern) small/large media and above-text toggles.
gaps.whyItMatters: The user has no idea a preview will be attached and no way to suppress it; a chat full of unwanted preview cards is the visible result. The 2013 client already had this panel.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m compose bar, reusing the existing TGLinkPreviewView for the panel body and -linkPreviewForText:withOptions: (already used for incoming bubbles at line ~1890, just never for the composer).
tdlib: linkPreviewOptions on inputMessageText - wrapped as +linkPreviewOptionsDisabled:url:forceSmallMedia:forceLargeMedia:showAboveText: (never passed by the send path, which hardcodes defaults)

gaps.name: Rich text runs inside Instant View articles
gaps.whatItIs: InstantPageTextItem renders each paragraph with bold/italic/fixed/marked styling and inline links, anchor links, mentions and email/phone runs, each tappable.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our reader flattens every block to a plain UILabel string (+textOfBlock:), so an article's inline links and emphasis vanish. Tapping a text block does nothing; tapping a media block opens the whole article in Safari. For a reader whose point is offline, low-bandwidth reading on a 4S, losing every in-article link is a real loss.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGInstantViewController inside TGChatViewController.m - the same CoreText label as gap 1, fed with the block's "runs" array that -instantViewForUrl: already returns. Telegraph has a full Objective-C precedent in TGInstantPageTextItem/TGInstantPage+TG.m worth porting.
tdlib: getWebPageInstantView - wrapped; block "runs" already flattened by TGClient+WebLinks

gaps.name: Instant View v2 structural blocks
gaps.whatItIs: Tables, collapsible details sections, related-articles lists, channel (chatLink) banners, collages and slideshows.
gaps.whyItMatters: These are common in real IV articles; every one of them currently renders as a blank or unsupported row, so parts of the article are simply missing with no indication. Details blocks in particular hide whole sections of text.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGInstantViewController +heightForBlock:/cellForRow: - add a scrollable table cell (horizontal UIScrollView), an expandable details row, and a related-articles row. Telegraph has TGInstantPageDetailsItem / table equivalents to port.
tdlib: getWebPageInstantView - the flattened block dictionaries already carry "rows", "isOpen", "articles", "blocks"

gaps.name: Instant View footer chrome and sharing
gaps.whatItIs: View count, 'Leave a comment' feedback link, an action button to share the article or open the original page in the browser, and the settings popover (font size, theme).
gaps.whyItMatters: There is currently no way out of the reader other than Back - no share, no 'open original', no font size for a 320pt screen where 15pt body text on a 4S is the whole reading experience.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGInstantViewController: a right bar button opening the existing TGActionSheet with Share / Open in Safari / Copy Link, a footer cell for viewCount and feedbackLink, and a font-size row backed by NSUserDefaults.
tdlib: getWebPageInstantView - already returns viewCount, feedbackLink, isFull

gaps.name: Non-article link preview types rendered as their media
gaps.whatItIs: A preview whose type is photo/video/audio/document/sticker/animation is drawn as the media itself rather than as a title+description card, and tapping it plays or opens the media in-app.
gaps.whyItMatters: TGLinkPreviewView only lays out title/description plus a thumbnail, so a link to a Telegram photo, a voice message or an mp3 is shown as a small grey card instead of the content, and tapping it leaves for Safari.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGLinkPreviewView in TGChatViewController.m: branch on the already-provided "mediaKind" and reuse the existing photo/audio/document attachment views.
tdlib: linkPreview types - already flattened into "mediaKind", "mediaFileId", "duration", "fileName" by +flattenedLinkPreview:

gaps.name: Login-URL keyboard buttons (Seamless Telegram Login)
gaps.whatItIs: An inlineKeyboardButtonTypeLoginUrl press shows a confirmation naming the site and the bot, with an optional 'allow to write to me' toggle, then opens the authorised URL.
gaps.whyItMatters: Bots that log you into a website are common; without the confirmation flow the button is either inert or leaks the raw URL. The bot layer already classifies the button kind as "loginUrl" but nothing consumes it.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m inline keyboard button handling, reusing the existing external-link confirmation sheet.
tdlib: getLoginUrlInfo / getLoginUrl - wrapped as -loginUrlInfoForButton:inMessage:inChat:completion: and -loginUrlForButton:... (both unused)

gaps.name: Unknown tg:// deep link explanation
gaps.whatItIs: For a tg:// link this build does not understand, the server supplies human-readable text and a flag for whether an app update would help; the client shows it in an alert instead of failing silently.
gaps.whyItMatters: This is exactly the case a 2013-era client hits constantly - links for features we do not implement. Right now the user gets a generic 'This link cannot be opened.'
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatViewController.m -openLink:, in the branch that currently shows the generic alert.

gaps.name: Recently visited t.me links in search
gaps.whatItIs: Global search offers a section of recently opened t.me URLs (users, groups, invite links, sticker sets) with title, member count and photo.
gaps.whyItMatters: Small, but it is the only path back to a public chat you opened by link and never joined; without it the link is gone once it scrolls out of the chat.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGSearchViewController as an extra section above results.

gaps.name: Embedded content blocks in Instant View (iframes, YouTube, tweets)
gaps.whatItIs: pageBlockEmbedded and pageBlockEmbeddedPost render third-party HTML in a web view, inline in the article.
gaps.whyItMatters: Real articles embed videos and tweets; those blocks are blank in our reader.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGInstantViewController - best we can do is render the poster image from "photoFileId" and open "url" in Safari on tap, which is worth doing as a fallback.
tdlib: getWebPageInstantView - block already carries photoFileId and url
